result.instructions: Tools for Zoko, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the customers who have a tag called VIP."; "Show the delivery history of the last message I sent to a customer."; "Which approved message templates can I use for a shipping update?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zoko data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zoko_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zoko_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zoko_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zoko_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zoko_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers (contacts) on this Zoko account. Zoko API: GET /v2/customer.

tools.name: zoko_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer's details by id. Zoko API: GET /v2/customer/{id}.

customer_id.description: Zoko id (from the list or get tools).

tools.name: zoko_list_message_templates

message_id.description: Zoko id (from the list or get tools).

tools.name: zoko_get_message_history
tools.title: Get message delivery history
tools.description: Get the delivery history (sent, delivered, read, failed) of one message. Zoko API: GET /v2/message/{id}/history.

message_id.description: Zoko id (from the list or get tools).

tools.name: zoko_send_message
tools.title: Send WhatsApp message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message to one customer through Zoko. Sends to a real person: only send with the customer's consent. Use type 'text' with `message` (only inside the 24-hour customer-service window), or type 'template' with `template_id` and optional `template_args` (for any time). Zoko API: POST /v2/message.

recipient.description: Recipient phone number, digits only with country code (e.g. 919876543210).

type.description: 'text' for a free-form message, 'template' for an approved template.

template_args.description: Placeholder values for the template, in order (type 'template').
